name: Posnic
tagline: Offline-first open source POS and billing software
description: Posnic is offline-first open source POS and billing software for retail shops and restaurants. It supports local checkout, inventory, receipts, reporting, and role-based workflows through desktop and self-hosted server editions, with optional online access.

features.title: Point-of-sale checkout
features.description: Records sales and produces receipts at the checkout counter

features.title: Offline-first operation
features.description: Runs the local POS without requiring a Posnic account or continuous internet access

features.title: Inventory management
features.description: Tracks products, stock levels, purchases, and stock movements

features.title: Billing and reporting
features.description: Supports billing records and operational sales reports

features.title: Role-based workflows
features.description: Provides separate administrator, manager, and cashier access

features.title: Desktop and server editions
features.description: Offers desktop packages plus a self-hosted server installation path

notes.text: The Community Edition runs locally; online and managed-cloud options are separate deployment choices.
